products.name: Lovo (Genny)
products.note: Voice cloning and synthesis; likeness consent; commercial voiceover; synthetic media disclosure

reading.body:
Lovo is a voice cloning and synthesis company whose only listed product, Genny, is built around likeness consent and synthetic media disclosure.

The data covers one product in one category, Voice and Audio. It records that consent and disclosure are part of the product's stated scope, which places Lovo among the AI companies that generate a person's voice rather than only text or images.

That distinction matters for AI scaling in a narrow way. Voice cloning is an inference workload, and inference runs on the same compute and power as everything else. But nothing here reports model size, training volume, or any facility, so the data cannot say how much compute Lovo draws or where it draws it from.

The entry also lists an unrelated MCP server for an 18+ AI companion service, which appears to be a naming collision rather than a Lovo product. The dataset gives no funding, headcount, customer, or infrastructure figures, so it supports a description of what Lovo sells and the consent terms attached to it, and nothing about its scale.
